normalized.title: Nitrogen and helium fluid networks modernization in Payload Facilities (EPCU)
normalized.description:
Within Payload Facilities (EPCU S1, S3B, S5), the fluid networks (nitrogen and helium) are used by payload customers for campaign activities and also by EPCU operators for maintenance and operational activities. 

From one facility to another and/or within the same building, the nitrogen and helium fluid networks are different. These differences are due to initial design of the network but also to changes made on some networks and not on others. 
The objective is to : 
•	Remove disparities between networks
•	Modernize the design of the fluid networks in order to improve control, maintenance and operability
•	Create an architecture allowing the monitoring of systems in real time
•	Improve the reliability of an aging network subject to numerous leaks (introduce new materials, new technologies…)
